products.short_description: The end-to-end Oracle C2M installation and multi-environment build — certified prereqs, OUAF install, WebLogic domain, database setup, config — consistent across Dev/Test/Prod, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stand up Oracle Customer to Meter — correctly, in every environment

Installing Oracle Utilities Customer to Meter (C2M) across Development, Test, and Production is where utility programs stall — certified stacks, OUAF setup, WebLogic domains, and database schemas all have to line up. This solution is the end-to-end C2M installation and multi-environment build: certified prerequisites, OUAF/product install, WebLogic domain creation, database initial setup, and environment configuration — done consistently across Dev/Test/Prod, pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M/OUAF architecture (product home, WebLogic domain, database schema), the certified stack, and the standard build model across environments.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensed C2M + WebLogic 14c entitlement, certified OS/JDK/DB, environment access, MOS access).
  • Installation Guide — exact ordered steps: certified prereqs, OUAF/product install, WebLogic domain creation, database initial setup, environment configuration (`configureEnv`/`initialSetup`), and post-install validation, per environment.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (product up, domain healthy, schema valid) plus Best Practices for repeatable multi-environment builds.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Oracle C2M installed and configured consistently in every environment — certified, healthy, and reproducible — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MINST-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of a host's C2M build prerequisites
    • OC2MINST-Remediation.sh — safe, dry-run-by-default fixes for common C2M build issues
    • OC2MINST-Report.sql — read-only build/schema report for a C2M database
    • OC2MINST-ScopeHelper.sh — resolve and confirm the target C2M environment before you act
    • OC2MINST-Validation.py — read-only WLST post-install validation of the C2M WebLogic domain

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
